title: knema glauca
intro: Knema glauca, commonly known as the Yellow Myrtle or Yellow Kamani, is a plant species in the family Myristicaceae, native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Knema glauca include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Knema glauca are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Knema glauca include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
